en: A monochrome postcard showing a tall Romanesque-Gothic bell tower rising above a cluster of old stone rooftops. The tower has several stacked arcaded levels and ends in a pyramidal spire topped with a cross. A few birds sit on the foreground roofs, and the sky behind the tower is cloudy with some visible stains or damage on the photograph. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
